about: The conformance corpus (design §44 §10.4, SDK1 Task 4). Recorded from a real `loams dev` by sdks/conformance/record-fixtures.mjs and replayed by sdks/conformance/fixture-server.mjs.

cases.name: instance_get_instance_json
cases.about: A successful unary call, no auth: what this instance is. This is the case a client makes before anything else, on a cold start. (The proto3 JSON mapping, which is what `curl` sends (design §44 §4).)

cases.name: instance_get_instance_proto
cases.about: A successful unary call, no auth: what this instance is. This is the case a client makes before anything else, on a cold start. (The binary encoding, which is what an SDK sends by default.)

cases.name: instance_get_instance_grpc_web
cases.about: A successful unary call, no auth: what this instance is. This is the case a client makes before anything else, on a cold start. (gRPC-Web, the framing a browser sends. One length-prefixed frame: flag 0 and a zero-length message.)

cases.name: instance_get_instance_grpc_web_json
cases.about: A successful unary call, no auth: what this instance is. This is the case a client makes before anything else, on a cold start. (gRPC-Web carrying the proto3 JSON mapping, which a browser SDK can ask for.)

cases.name: instance_who_am_i_json
cases.about: A structured-reason error: `unimplemented` carrying an ErrorInfo whose reason is `not_implemented`, because this build has no authentication yet. An SDK branches on the reason, never on the message. (The proto3 JSON mapping, which is what `curl` sends (design §44 §4).)

cases.name: instance_who_am_i_grpc_web
cases.about: A structured-reason error: `unimplemented` carrying an ErrorInfo whose reason is `not_implemented`, because this build has no authentication yet. An SDK branches on the reason, never on the message. (gRPC-Web, the framing a browser sends. One length-prefixed frame: flag 0 and a zero-length message.)

cases.name: live_query_json
cases.about: The unavailable-service path on a unary RPC: `loams.live.v1` is a `full`-variant engine, so every one of its RPCs answers `unimplemented` with reason `feature_not_in_variant` and the variant in `metadata`. (The proto3 JSON mapping, which is what `curl` sends (design §44 §4).)

(gRPC-Web, the framing a browser sends. One length-prefixed frame: flag 0 and a zero-length message.)

cases.name: live_watch
cases.about: The unavailable-service path on a server stream: the refusal arrives inside the Connect streaming envelope, not as an HTTP status. An SDK that reports it has to read the envelope.
